msg: Choose quickly, make sure to make a selection for each pair. Don't get so caught up in the choice that you forget to collect the mushrooms on the next screen. The color of gnome with high amounts of mushrooms awarded seems to come in waves, so find the high scoring gnome of each pair through trial and error and stick to that color until it starts awarding low scores (less than 3). Sometimes you will seemingly only have the choice of two low scores in a row, so don't worry about those ones.
